## Discovery & Translational Science

**The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry: Chirality Abounds** [Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/2026-nobel-prize-chemistry-chirality-abounds)
- Explores the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry focusing on molecular chirality, enantiomers, and symmetry planes.

**The ternary complex structure as a foundation for structure-guided molecular glue design** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42865110/)
- Discusses structural biology principles governing ternary complex formation to enable rational, structure-guided design of molecular glues.

**Discovery of a Potent and Selective First-In-Class Antagonist of GPR15 With In Vivo Anti-Obesity Activity** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42865071/)
- Reports the identification of a potent, selective, first-in-class GPR15 antagonist demonstrating anti-obesity efficacy in vivo.

**Polypharmacological Target-Aware Molecule Generation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42865030/ )
- Details a computational framework for generating targeted drug-like molecules capable of addressing multiple pharmacological targets simultaneously.

**Filling the massive AI drug discovery data gap** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00137-y)
- Charlotte Deane of the OpenBind initiative highlights the critical need for expanded high-throughput protein-small molecule binding datasets to power artificial intelligence in drug discovery.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

**First Tracks climbs on ‘impressive’ celiac study data** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/first-tracks-celiac-study-results-cd122/832726/)
- **[Biotech]** First Tracks Biotherapeutics reported that its experimental anti-CD122 drug ANB033 significantly improved protection of the intestinal lining from gluten-induced damage compared to placebo over six weeks in a Phase 1/2 celiac disease trial.
- The drug prevented symptom increases during a gluten challenge with no serious treatment-related adverse events; a second cohort readout is expected in Q1, with late-stage trials targeted for 2027.

**[Biotech]** **First Tracks lines up late-stage plans** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/first-tracks-celiac-study-results-cd122/832726/)
- Following positive early data for ANB033 in celiac disease, the company prepares for cohort two data in Q1 2027 and subsequent pivotal evaluation.

**[Biotech]** **Syndax announces MAXPIRe Phase 2 trial topline results of axatilimab in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109736444797522028)
- Syndax reported that the Phase 2 MAXPIRe trial evaluating axatilimab in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis did not meet its primary endpoint of reducing the annualized rate of forced vital capacity (FVC) decline.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

**Bristol Myers dips on ‘confounding’ lung drug results** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/bristol-myers-admilparant-lpa1-ipf-aloft-results-contineum/832715/)
- **[Big Pharma]** Bristol Myers Squibb announced that its Phase 3 trial of the LPA1 receptor antagonist admilparant in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) successfully slowed breathing capacity decline over one year, but efficacy was restricted to the 60 mg dose arm.
- The 120 mg high-dose arm failed to reach statistical significance, presenting confounding results that analysts noted require further clarification alongside past liver-related safety monitoring adjustments.

**[Big Pharma]** **BioNTech announces AHEAD-MERIT Phase 2/3 clinical trial results** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109959879247139090)
- BioNTech reported that the AHEAD-MERIT Phase 2/3 trial evaluating the mRNA cancer immunotherapy candidate BNT113 did not meet its first dual primary endpoint of progression-free survival (PFS).

## Regulatory & Approvals

**[Biotech]** **SABS receives FDA Fast Track Designation for SAB-142 in Stage 3 Type 1 Diabetes** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109990294183870924)
- The FDA granted Fast Track designation to SAB-142 for the treatment of Stage 3 Type 1 diabetes.

## Business & Strategy

**Parkinson’s cell therapy developer files to go public** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/aspen-neuroscience-ipo-plans-s-1-parkinsons-cell-therapy/832732/)
- **[Biotech]** Aspen Neuroscience filed for an initial public offering on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ASPE to fund late-stage development of its autologous dopamine-producing neuron cell therapy, sasineprocel (ANPD001), for Parkinson's disease.
- The company has raised approximately $347 million since its 2018 inception, positioning itself as a pioneer in taking a Parkinson's-specific autologous cell therapy toward registrational evaluation.

**Bausch + Lomb swaps CEOs; Merck reveals anticipated eye drug data** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/bausch-lomb-saunders-remigromig-tezpire-eoe-hovilpri/832495/)
- **[Big Pharma]** Bausch + Lomb board chair Thomas Appio stepped in as interim CEO, replacing Brent Saunders after a mutually agreed departure, while the company concurrently hiked its full-year 2026 earnings outlook.
- Merck & Co. released detailed safety data for its late-stage diabetic macular edema drug remigromig following its prior success announcement.

**[Big Pharma]** **Roche enters into obesity drug licensing agreement** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109948262551814211)
- Roche secured an obesity drug licensing deal worth up to $1.16 billion with China-based Rona Therapeutics.

**[Biotech]** **Intellia Therapeutics appoints Jing L. Marantz as Chief Medical Officer** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109971176512778401)
- Intellia Therapeutics announced the appointment of former Scholar Rock executive Jing L. Marantz as its new Chief Medical Officer.

**[Biotech]** **Chardan initiates coverage on Gossamer Bio with Buy rating and $160 price target** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109956511304962226)
- Chardan initiated equity research coverage on Gossamer Bio with a Buy rating and a price target of $160.

## Public Health & Policy

**How many ways can the Trump administration clamp down on international researchers?** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/13/health-news-trump-admin-clamps-down-on-international-researchers/?utm_campaign=rss)
- The Trump administration issued two sweeping announcements in a span of two days aimed at tightening restrictions on international students and scholars.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [What If Healthcare Worked Before You Got Sick?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1_bq5ZVTnLM) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Allon Bloch advocates for transitioning from traditional reactive "sick care" to personalized, accessible preventive care.
        - The model aims to deliver immediate care for simple health needs anywhere the patient is located.
        - The framework establishes pathways to connect patients with specialized medical experts whenever complex issues arise.
    - [Built on ChatGPT? Rethink Your Entire Business Model](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/x3z1oYjQW4E) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Sergei Polevikov addresses healthcare innovators building applications directly on top of ChatGPT.
        - He warns that relying on third-party foundational models requires re-evaluating what makes a digital health business defensible.
        - The discussion highlights the strategic risks and business model challenges for AI wrapper startups in the healthtech sector.
    - [Healthcare Without Interfaces: The Future of Ambient Systems](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aPCQQMSfiow) -- Health2Tech
        - Increasing the number of software dashboards creates friction and competes for clinicians' active attention during consultations.
        - Ambient AI systems process consultation context quietly in the background to streamline clinical documentation without requiring direct screen interactions.
        - Future ambient systems are designed to anticipate clinical needs and coordinate follow-up tasks directly within existing workflows.
        - Invisible background systems still mandate strict governance measures, including security controls, comprehensive audit logs, and continuous human review.
- Pure Science
    - [The Clearest Material Ever Made](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NiCgcUTL9_Q) -- Veritasium
        - Explores the shift from copper wire communications—which suffer from capacity limits and high-frequency skin effect losses—to high-purity glass fiber optics.
        - Analyzes the physics of optical signal loss in glass, focusing on the mechanisms of light scattering and intrinsic material absorption.
        - Covers the specialized chemical manufacturing techniques developed to remove minute impurities and synthesize ultra-clear fiber optic glass.
        - Demonstrates how super-pure optical fiber manufacturing provided the foundational infrastructure required for modern global internet communication.
    - [13 - Flimsy  #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/oTPjmX350FE) -- El Jj
        - The video re-examines the mathematical topic of the sum of natural numbers ($\sum n$).
        - It contributes another perspective to the popular mathematical debate surrounding divergent infinite series.
        - The entry is produced as part of the channel's "#mathctober" series on mathematical concepts.
- Economics
    - [10 ANS DE MACRON : L’HEURE DU BILAN [ARGENT MAGIQUE]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MFy5VnJ2PPE) -- Heu?reka
        - The video presents an economic review of Emmanuel Macron's ten years in power within the context of a presidential election year.
        - It analyzes Macron's record against the backdrop of several decades of neoliberal economic policies.
        - The content is co-authored by Arnaud Gantier from Stupid Economics alongside journalists Marino and Heu?reka, produced by Stup Media.
